Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis specifically focuses on the comparison between mock-infected and HIV-1 infected CD4+ T cells across a time course to identify changes during productive and latent phases. While several drug treatments (ATO, FeCl3, MG132, etc.) are mentioned in the text, they are primarily used for validation via Western Blot or Immunofluorescence; the primary DIA proteomics dataset is tied to the infection time course.
